title: Kirli Peri Masalı
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: The trilogy reaches its devastating conclusion in A Twisted Fairy Tale. After surviving a deadly fire and escaping both the police and relentless enemies, Yosun and Özgür take refuge in a remote mountain house with Mr K and Anıl. But the past does not stay buried. Secrets move through the house like restless ghosts, and the group soon finds themselves at the center of an event that will shake not only their lives, but the entire country. As past and present losses collide, each character is dragged into their own personal hell. In this final descent, survival is no longer guaranteed, and the question remains: will anyone make it out intact?
